sources: Mind's Eye Theatre: Laws of the Reckoning (WW05037), "Virtue Traits" p.90: three Virtues - Mercy, Vision, Zeal - a character assigns three Traits among at creation, with the creed's own primary Virtue always at least equal to the others. Experience p.269: "Virtues and edges cannot be purchased with Experience; edges can only be gained when new Virtue Traits are acquired, and Virtues can only [be] raised by cashing in 10 temporary Conviction Traits."
